summary: Prevents the advisory PR assistant from overwriting Release Please-owned titles and release classifications after generated release metadata changes.

notes: This workflow ownership correction does not change application data or migrations.

security: The guard relies on the repository-owned Release Please branch namespace and runs before any label or title mutation.
documentation: Release-label workflow contract coverage records the exclusive Release Please ownership boundary.
knownLimitations: The PR assistant remains advisory for generated release pull requests; the dedicated release labeler owns their classification.
rollback: Revert the ownership guard and contract test, then manually normalize generated release pull request labels after every metadata refresh.
validation: Run the focused release-label workflow contract tests and release-note preflight.
Verify the generated release pull request retains release:breaking after Release Please edits its body and branch.
